texts:
Your AI has a brain. Give it a body. In the Forge, text or photos become textured 3D models you can orbit, view in AR and download.

Pick the engine that builds it, and several are free to use. Below the prompt, a live feed shows what other people just forged, each one ready to open in the viewer or remix.

Quality has three tiers: Draft, Standard and High. High is a $THREE holder feature: hold to unlock, or pay per generation.

Open the Forge and try a prompt: three.ws/forge

issues.quote: Your AI has a brain. Give it a body.
issues.problem: The post opens with a metaphor instead of the mechanism. The house contract requires the strongest true statement first and to say what the thing does in the order a person would notice it. This line tells a reader nothing checkable about the Forge and assumes they already have an AI.
issues.fix: Replace the opening with "In the Forge, text or photos become textured 3D models you can orbit, view in AR and download."

issues.quote: Your AI has a brain. Give it a body.
issues.problem: A reader who has never heard of three.ws cannot tell from this line what the product is or does. The first line must carry the strongest true statement so the post stands alone before Show more.
issues.fix: Lead with "In the Forge, text or photos become textured 3D models you can orbit, view in AR and download."

issues.quote: Your AI has a brain. Give it a body.
issues.problem: This is a vague metaphor, not a mechanism or checkable fact. The first line should state what the Forge accepts as input and produces as output.
issues.fix: Open with "In the Forge, text or photos become textured 3D models you can orbit, view in AR and download."

editor.summary: The post’s claims verify against the live Forge page, but the opening metaphor “Your AI has a brain. Give it a body.” fails the house rule to lead with the mechanism. Replace it with the exact product line about text or photos becoming textured 3D models so the first 280 characters carry the strongest true statement.
